title: RAW Sidecar Sanity
user: A photographer importing RAW plus camera JPEG pairs who needs to catch impossible dimensions, aspect ratios, or timestamps before a catalog makes bad thumbnails and timelines.
smallest_useful_product: Local drag-and-drop checker for a folder manifest or selected RAW/JPEG pairs; reports dimension, aspect, timestamp, and basename conflicts with a CSV export.
success_measure: On a labelled corpus of 200 valid and intentionally mismatched pairs, detect at least 95% of injected date/aspect/basename conflicts with under 3% false positives.
constraints: Browser RAW parsing coverage will be incomplete; document supported metadata readers; never modify originals; avoid retaining image bytes.
